Full Stack Developer 
 Req number: 
R8717 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Hybrid 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have strong .NET Core application development, SQL, and API integration experience, and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to provide application development, systems analysis, maintenance, integration, testing, and production support for a customer communications and service alerting platform and related applications. This position will support the continued reliability, security, scalability, and modernization of the platform while participating throughout the software development lifecycle. This position will be a contract and hybrid in Washington, DC or Alexandria, VA. 
 Due to the specific legal and contractual requirements associated with this position, this role will be direct employment with CAI. This position does not offer work authorization sponsorship now or in the future. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions
 Review project specifications, workflow diagrams, process flows, and system documentation to determine application requirements and technical approaches
 Design, develop, modify, test, implement, and maintain software applications, interfaces, integrations, and supporting system components
 Develop application code, scripts, database objects, and automated processes based on business and technical requirements
 Develop and maintain APIs, data interfaces, integrations, and data exchange processes supporting customer communications and related systems
 Create, modify, and optimize database queries, stored procedures, and data models to support application performance and functionality
 Perform unit, integration, and system testing and support user acceptance testing activities
 Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, application issues, integration problems, and production incidents
 Monitor application performance and implement or recommend improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and maintainability
 Support software releases, upgrades, patches, deployments, and application lifecycle management activities
 Develop and maintain technical documentation, system specifications, workflow diagrams, operating procedures, and user support materials
 Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, business analysts, architects, developers, system administrators, and operational personnel throughout the software development lifecycle
 Participate in Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, and continuous improvement activities
 Follow applicable cybersecurity requirements, technology standards, development practices, and governance policies
 Provide production support and technical assistance for customer alerting and related applications
 Support application modernization initiatives, technology upgrades, systems integration, and system enhancement efforts
 Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and maintain documentation supporting operational continuity and long-term system maintenance
 Prepare status updates, technical reports, analyses, and recommendations as requested
 Coordinate with technical resources to support project objectives and operational requirements
 Perform other related technical duties supporting the operation, maintenance, enhancement, and modernization of the platform and associated systems
 What You’ll Need 
 Required:
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Relevant additional experience may be considered in place of education requirements
 Minimum of eight (8) years of professional experience in application development, systems analysis, software programming, application maintenance, or related information technology disciplines
 Minimum of five (5) years of experience developing, modifying, testing, implementing, and supporting enterprise software applications
 Hands-on software development experience with .NET Core and Node.js
 Experience designing, developing, and working with databases using Microsoft SQL Server and/or NoSQL technologies
 Demonstrated experience analyzing business and technical requirements and translating them into software solutions
 Experience troubleshooting and resolving software defects, application issues, and system performance problems
 Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, workflow diagrams, system specifications, and user support materials
 Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment
 Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance
 Experience developing and supporting web-based and enterprise applications
 Experience developing, supporting, or integrating APIs, web services, and system interfaces
 Experience with application testing, debugging, issue resolution, and performance optimization
 Experience with source code repositories and version control tools such as Git or similar technologies
 Experience implementing and supporting secure application development practices
 Preferred:
 Experience supporting transit, transportation, public-sector, or government organizations
 Experience with GraphQL, OpenTripPlanner (OTP), GTFS, GTFS-Realtime, or related transit technologies
 Experience working within Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, or CI/CD environments
 Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud technologies
 Experience supporting application modernization, systems integration, and enterprise technology initiatives
 Industry certifications related to software development, cloud technologies, Agile methodologies, or system administration
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
  
 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
 
 
 EEO Statement 
 It is the policy of Computer Aid, Inc.(CAI) not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran. It is also the policy of CAI to take affirmative action to employ and to advance in employment, all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment. 
   
 Employees and applicants of CAI will not be subject to harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran. Additionally, retaliation, including intimidation, threats, or coercion, because an employee or applicant has objected to discrimination, engaged or may engage in filing a complaint, assisted in a review, investigation, or hearing or have otherwise sought to obtain their legal rights under any Federal, State, or local EEO law is prohibited. 
$70 - $80 per hour The pay range for this position is listed above. Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including location, experience, and education. Benefit packages include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as 401k retirement account access. Employees in this role may also be entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.
